## Understanding the Theory: ROC AUC from Scores

### Core Intuition: Why Do We Need This?

### Mathematical Principles & Formulation
The operation is governed by the following mathematical formulation:

$$
\text{AUC} = \frac{\sum_{i \in \text{Pos}} \text{Rank}(s_i) - \frac{N_{\text{pos}}(N_{\text{pos}}+1)}{2}}{N_{\text{pos}} \cdot N_{\text{neg}}}
$$

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def ml_roc_auc(x):
    """
    ROC AUC from Scores
    """
    x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    return np.round(x_arr, 4).tolist()
```
